subject: Letter received for Kowloon Bay Dental Limited - Pacific Star MPF Master Trust
body:
Dear Dr Leung Ka Yan,

We have received a letter for Kowloon Bay Dental Limited from Pacific Star MPF Master Trust. It is a notice of default contribution and surcharge for MPF mandatory contributions for September 2026.

Please arrange to pay HK$33,075 by 14 November 2026. A scanned copy of the letter is attached for your reference.

Please let us know if you would like our assistance in arranging the payment.

Best regards,
CWC CPA
